title: ingest: ChangeCompactor writes the merged TTL back into the caller's LedgerCloseMeta when two transactions extend the same TTL entry

target.versions_affected: v0.9.0 and main 4cee0255 (the code involved is the same in both; lower bound not established)

severity_basis: addUpdatedChange writes maxTTL through change.Post.Data.Ttl, a pointer into the caller's LedgerCloseMeta, so compacting a ledger in which a later transaction extends a TTL entry less than an earlier one changes that transaction's meta in the input; the compacted result is right. Silent input mutation on a rare input (CAP-63 parallel extensions); the Horizon impact the issue describes was read, not run.

entries.expected: compacting the ledger's changes leaves the input LedgerCloseMeta unchanged
entries.observed: Not run by the kit against go-stellar-sdk's change readers. By hand on v0.9.0 on this ledger (stellar-core's 'parallel txs|basic test', protocol 23, ledger 34): after NewCompactingChangeReader, transaction 7's TTL update 46 -> 234 reads 46 -> 434, and the re-marshalled ledger differs from the input.

evidence.pre_fix: Executed by hand outside the kit's runs, with the reproduction in the upstream issue; no run of the kit compares this behaviour, so no report row exists. The issue's standalone program on v0.9.0 and main 4cee0255: after compaction, tx B's updated entry reads liveUntilLedgerSeq = 434 (was 234). The same with stellar-core's test ledger 34 of the parallel phase test through NewLedgerChangeReaderFromLedgerCloseMeta and NewCompactingChangeReader.
evidence.expected_basis: CAP-63 (https://github.com/stellar/stellar-protocol/blob/master/core/cap-0063.md#ttl-ledger-change-semantics): each transaction's meta shows its own TTL update and the ledger keeps the larger value; a reader of the meta does not change it.

reproduction.method: The run the issue reports, made on v0.9.0 and main 4cee0255 before filing on 2026-11-19: tx B's TTL in the input reads 434 after compaction.

queries: stellar/go-stellar-sdk: every issue and pull request since 2026-11-01
stellar/go-stellar-sdk: the branches with commits since 2026-11-01

history.note: Recorded on 2026-11-19: filed by the maintainers of this kit on 2026-11-19 as https://github.com/stellar/go-stellar-sdk/issues/6055; this record restates the public issue.
